text: Hearth is a private family photo app for split families and grandparents. A grandparent opens it to see the newest photos from the family: this week there are 6 new photos from Mom's group and 2 from Dad's group, with captions like "Emma's first soccer goal". Build the home screen.

Role Radar scans job boards each weekday and tracks senior product manager roles. A job seeker reads a ranked list each morning to decide which to apply to: for example Senior PM at Northwind Health, remote, score 87; Staff PM at Larkspur Pay, Charlotte, score 74; Group PM at Fernway, hybrid, score 61. Build the list screen.

Crew Clock lets a small construction crew clock in and out by phone, and it uses their location only at the moment they punch. A crew member who is not tech savvy changes whether the app may use their location, and sees what it was used for. Build the settings screen.
Crew Clock again. A boss adds a new job site with a name, a street address and a radius in feet within which crew can clock in, and can mark it active or paused. Build the form.

ccwatts is an open-source command line tool that reads local Claude Code logs and estimates the electricity that usage consumed, always as a range with sourced assumptions. A developer decides whether to install it. Build the landing page.

ccwatts shows a week of estimated energy use from Claude Code logs: this week 4.2 kWh, range 2.9 to 6.1, down 12% from last week, with the busiest day Wednesday. A developer checks the week's total and range at a glance. Build the dashboard.
Role Radar has no saved jobs yet and no applications. A new user, who just finished setting up their search, needs to know the first step. Build the empty state.
Charlie suggests paper trades for learning only, no real money. A learner confirms a practice trade: buy 1 contract on a stock option, cost $140, maximum loss $140. Build the confirmation dialog.
